# GrowthWithMBA — M. Bin Amir

GrowthWithMBA is the personal brand and professional portfolio website of M. Bin Amir, providing digital product building and social media growth marketing.

## Primary Services

### 1. AI Product Building & Vibe Coding
- Custom web applications and digital tools built using modern AI development platforms.
- Websites, web apps, MVPs, and rapid product prototypes.
- Stack & Platforms: Antigravity, Lovable, Replit, Supabase, Google AI Studio, Vercel, React, Tailwind CSS.

### 2. Social Media Management & Growth Marketing
- Organic social media management and Instagram growth strategies.
- Content strategy, content planning, brand positioning, and audience research.
- Targeted Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram Ads, lead generation campaigns).

## Verified Case Studies & Results

- Jamia Dar ul Quran: Meta ad lead generation campaign yielding 850+ verified call inquiries (PKR 60,000 ad spend).

- Mukaf: Social media management and strategy generating +700% organic reach and +320% profile activity.
- Video Editing Agency: Out-of-network video hook campaign driving +148% views and +150% non-follower reach.
